items.rationale: The washing-machine leak is an escape of water under §2.4.2, and §7.1.7(h) covers necessary cleaning of the affected floor. Estimate one gross cleaning charge of €80.
The hallway was reached by the escaped water, so necessary floor cleaning is covered under §7.1.7(h). Estimate one gross cleaning charge of €85.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers checking the source and confirming that it no longer leaks, even if the appliance itself is not insured. Estimate one gross inspection charge of €90.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged skirting
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover dismantling and disposal of the damaged fixed trim. Estimate one gross charge of €75.

Fixed trim is a building component under §4.2.2, and §§7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow like-for-like replacement. Estimate €140 installed, bringing lines 1–5 to €470 gross, consistent with the comparable Case 12 bundle.

items.description: Clean and repaint unaffected upstairs bedroom
items.rationale: Sections 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude work in a room not affected by the leak. One gross job would be about €600 if covered.

items.description: Measure floor moisture in the two affected rooms
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary moisture measurements in the affected rooms. Estimate €165 gross for the single billed survey, in line with the Case 21 measurement charge.

Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary drying, while §7.1.8(c) bars duplication of the separately billed rental and labour. Allow €230 gross for the drying service itself; lines 7–10 total €642, within the Case 12 bundled range.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers equipment hire for necessary drying, provided the hire is not already included in another line. Estimate €95 gross for the single rental charge.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour not already billed elsewhere. The stated prior gives 4 hours × €38 gross = €152.

items.description: Measure and dry basement storage room
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) exclude drying in a separate room with no documented water damage. Estimate €450 gross for the combined service if covered.

Section 5.2.6 covers specialist transport only from the balance left after restoration under the single €1,190 gross cap. Restoration is expected to exhaust the cap; if sufficient balance remains, estimate €100 for the one transport charge.
Under §5.2.6, the assessment qualifies but is paid only from the cap balance after restoration and the earlier transport line. If a balance reaches this line, estimate €120 gross after the cap.
Section 5.2.6 covers stabilisation only from the balance after restoration, transport and assessment. If any balance reaches this line, estimate €150 gross after the cap.
Section 5.2.6 gives restoration first priority under the cap for the unscheduled painting. Full specialist restoration is expected to exceed the cap of €1,000 net × 1.19 = €1,190 gross.

Section 5.2.6 requires the item itself to have been affected by the insured event, so the second painting does not qualify. If it qualified and restoration reached the unscheduled-item cap, the threshold would be €1,190 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate administrative and processing charges. The conditional estimate for one flat fee is €35 gross.
